<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$audit-skill-portfolio</code></p>

Audit installed skills for context cost, scope, duplicates, invocation policy, and trigger overlap. Use only when explicitly invoked with $audit-skill-portfolio; remain read-only and return evidence-backed portfolio actions.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link audit-skill-portfolio --scope user
arcantry skills link audit-skill-portfolio --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link audit-skill-portfolio --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Find overlapping installed skills

**Prompt**

> Use $audit-skill-portfolio to inspect my installed skills and identify the strongest consolidation candidates.

**Expected outcome**

A read-only inventory that separates deterministic evidence from heuristic overlap and prioritizes a short decision list.

### Audit one repository catalog

**Prompt**

> Use $audit-skill-portfolio for this repository's project skills and check naming, invocation policy, and trigger collisions.

**Expected outcome**

A scoped catalog report with diagnostics and tier candidates, without installing, deleting, or rewriting skills.
